generalError.title: Ooops!
generalError.description: Something went wrong, try again later

generation.title: New Image
generation.inputPlaceholder: What would you like to see? Describe every detail for the best result...

styleDialog.title: Choose Your Style
styleDialog.text: Select from a list of popular styles to quickly add them to your prompt. These styles are simply text additions that influence the image generation. If your desired style isn’t listed, you can manually type it in your prompt, e.g., "in the style of Van Gogh."

promptValidationErrors.minLength: The prompt must be at least {{min}} characters long
promptValidationErrors.maxLength: The prompt must be shorter than {{max}} characters

modalError.title: Oops!
modalError.description: Something went wrong during the magic process. Please try again.

dialog.title: Enhancer Mode
dialog.description: When enabled, your prompt will be refined and expanded using AI to add more details, improving the quality and accuracy of the generated image.

dialog.title: Clear All User Data?
dialog.description: This action will permanently delete all user data and cannot be undone. Are you sure you want to proceed?

active.title: Censorship has been deactivated
active.description: With great power comes great responsibility

inactive.title: Censorship has been activated
inactive.description: It seems you are not ready for such power

deleteDialog.title: Are you sure?
deleteDialog.description: This action will permanently delete the generated image and cannot be undone. Are you sure you want to proceed?

empty.title: Nothing Here Yet...
empty.description: You haven't created any artwork yet. Start generating to see it appear here.

end.title: That's Everything So Far
end.description: But there's always room for more creativity. Ready to make something new?

promptExample: A futuristic city at sunset, glowing in orange and gold. A woman with red hair stands on a rooftop in a glowing kimono. Shimmering skyscrapers and flying vehicles add to the vibrant scene.
